answer: The karst counter is kept in dune and raven publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2434 identities would post 3866 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
